judged_text: For COLLECTIVE team events, team hosts' destinationCalendars are appended via `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...)`, which is a no-op when the organizer has no destinationCalendar (evt.destinationCalendar is null). The stated invariant of this PR — every collective host's destination calendar receives the event — silently fails whenever the organizer lacks a destinationCalendar: team hosts' calendars are dropped and events are only created via the default-credential fallback path.

The stated invariant of this PR — every collective host's destination calendar receives the event — silently fails whenever the organizer lacks a destinationCalendar: team hosts' calendars are dropped and events are only created via the default-credential fallback path.

adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). The subsequent COLLECTIVE logic uses `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`, which becomes a no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null/undefined`, so team hosts’ destination calendars are never appended. Downstream, `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents` only iterates destinations when `event.destinationCalendar && event.destinationCalendar.length > 0`; otherwise it takes the fallback path, dropping the intended per-host destination calendar creation.
